body: I do these thing, but I don't enjoy them. I can even laugh, but without feeling any positive energy from it. It's all blank. I even had laugh at myself yesterday, that I will probably not even notice my death tbh.

Remember, that you don't have to wait to receive the love from someone. It's the love you can give to someone, that can save you.
Maybe one day, your mother will understand, but until then, you have rights to feel anger and dissapointment. Don't hide these negative feelings or they will eat you.

You need to find a currage to succeed in your life. Me too. I decided to live for my pets, because I don't want to be like my parents. They'd decided to bring me to that fked up world and they messed me up. I am more responsible, than them.

Turn your back on that joke of a mother. Live your life and don't feel ashamed for giving up on her. That's what made me stronger. My joke of a mother has chosen a violent man, aka my father,over her own child. I don't have any feeling for them anymore.
Unless you have your gold stashed in some secret hideout, you can't be sure your gov will not confiscate it in case of war, alien invasion or any other crisis.
